title: Map incomplete TRX reader reasons to specific declared diagnostic codes
outcome: Incomplete TRX artifacts retain useful fixed internal reason codes without raw result text or verdict changes.
acceptance: The four existing reasons for missing outcome, ResultSummary, Counters and nonnumeric counter each map to a specific fixed diagnostic code instead of invalid_result.
Regression coverage exercises actual reader reasons and confirms fixed private output; parser verdicts and public contracts remain unchanged.
